en-US.description: Full-featured data prep platform designed for collaboration.
en-US.longDescription: Enso Analytics is a modern, workflow-based data preparation platform designed for teams. Keep your familiar, visual, no-code canvas and unlock powerful features: cross-platform support for Windows, Mac, and Linux, built-in scheduling, granular version history, and encrypted secrets. With seamless in-memory and in-database processing, your complex data prep runs efficiently where your data lives.
en-US.name: Enso
